prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserving animation key poses. Make a production sprite atlas for an offline children's learning app. Polished friendly storybook animal illustration with soft shaded fur/feathers/scales, clear anatomy and expressive eyes, matching the reference style. ONE animal identity reused in ALL cells, camera/head size/body proportions/markings EXACTLY consistent. Every pose is full body, no cropped limbs. All face RIGHT unless subject says front-facing. Equal square grid cells with 8% safe margins, consistent scale, same notional ground baseline 85% down each cell for grounded poses. The top LEFT cell is frame1 and order is row-major. The canonical brown eagle with white head, white tail, golden beak and talons. Flying horizontally, facing RIGHT, feet tucked. EIGHT successive wing-stroke poses: wings highest; three-quarter up; halfway up; out horizontally; halfway down; deepest downstroke; halfway down returning; halfway up returning. The chest, head, eye and tail are at identical pixel positions and the same scale in ALL cells; only the articulated wings change. Do not bob or redraw the head between poses.
